items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the Bußgeldbescheid
items.quote: Er muss binnen zwei Wochen ab der Zustellung schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift beim Landkreis Beispielheide eingelegt werden.
items.computation: The reverse side (Zustellungsurkunde, §182 ZPO) shows actual formal delivery on 17.10.2025 (Friday), which is the relevant anchor rather than any deemed-delivery fiction since the exact delivery date is documented. Under §187(1) BGB the day of delivery itself is not counted, so the two-week period starts on 18.10.2025. Two weeks (14 days) later is 31.10.2025 (Friday), but that day is Reformationstag, a public holiday in Niedersachsen, so under §31(3) VwVfG / §57(2) VwGO with §222(2) ZPO the deadline shifts to the next business day, Monday 03.11.2025.

items.title: Pay the total fine, fee and costs (Gesamtbetrag)
items.quote: Der Gesamtbetrag ist zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist, fällig; geben Sie bei der Überweisung bitte das Aktenzeichen an.
items.computation: The Bescheid becomes rechtskräftig (final) once the two-week Einspruch period lapses without an objection being filed; that period ends 03.11.2025, so the decision becomes final on 04.11.2025 (assuming no Einspruch is lodged). Under §187(1) BGB that day of the triggering event is not counted, so the further two-week payment period starts 05.11.2025 and runs 14 days to Tuesday 18.11.2025, which is an ordinary business day, so no further shift applies.

warnings: The payment due date (18.11.2025) assumes no Einspruch is filed within the two-week objection period; if an Einspruch is lodged, the fine is not yet due and the case proceeds instead — the person should not pay if they intend to object.

The letter is dated 13.10.2025 but the enclosed Zustellungsurkunde shows actual formal delivery on 17.10.2025; the later, documented delivery date was used to compute the Einspruch deadline as it is the legally relevant date for formal service.

The IBAN printed (DE61 2585 1660 0000 0055 66, Kreissparkasse Beispielheide) is a validly formed German IBAN, but as always the account holder should be verified independently before paying, e.g. via the Landkreis's official website, rather than relying solely on the letter.
